svg.title: FB_DriveSto - test D1: STO release, run, STO stop, drive fault, reset, ready lost
svg.text: FB_DriveSto - test D1: STO release, run, STO stop, drive fault, reset, ready lost
xSto is the read-only copy of the F-program STO state (TRUE = torque off). wCtrl = bit0 ON (1 if not STO) + bit1 RUN (2 in RUNNING) + bit7 fault acknowledge (128 for one call).
tick k (x 100 ms) - events change inputs before the call of that tick
iState 0 NOT READY, 1 READY, 2 RUNNING, 9 FAULT. tick 10: STO -> 0 (a normal safety stop, NOT a fault), xWarn because run is still requested ;
tick 17: reset ignored (fault still present) ; tick 21: reset accepted -> wCtrl 129 (ON + acknowledge) ; tick 25: ready lost while running -> alarm 3.
